series.title: U.S. software development total job postings
series.definition: U.S. Software Development occupational sector, total postings; seven-day trailing average. Daily observations refreshed weekly.
caveats: Indeed postings measure advertised demand, not hires, employment, or all U.S. vacancies.
Sector categories use normalized job titles rather than official occupation codes.
Historical data are revised; the repository documents a November 2024 seasonal adjustment methodology change.
The README uses percent-change wording, but its baseline example and CSV use an index with baseline 100. Values are retained without rebasing.
series.attribution: Indeed Hiring Lab, Indeed Job Postings Index, Software Development, United States.
